column1: # rustc-demangle 0.1.28's test vectors for v0 symbols, vendored so the test reads no network:
#   src/v0.rs, mod tests (each row names its test function);
#   src/lib.rs, limit_recursion, limit_output and the v0 symbol of interleaved_new_legacy.
# rustc-demangle is licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0; Copyright (c) 2014 Alex Crichton (its LICENSE-MIT).
# Columns, tab-separated: test, macro, symbol, expected, scope.
# Expected is rustc-demangle's alternate display ("{:#}"), the macros expanded:
#   t_nohash!(s, e) is (s, e); t_nohash_type!(a, b) is ("_RMC0" a, "<" b ">");
#   t_const!(m, v) and t_const_suffixed!(m, v, ty) are ("_RIC0K" m "E", "::<" v ">").
# The t! rows (the non-alternate display, with crate hashes and integer type suffixes) are left out:
# it is not the form a reviewed path is written in. "(error)" is a symbol rustc-demangle refuses;
# "(limit) TEXT" one whose display it cuts short with TEXT. recursion_limit_leaks and
# recursion_limit_backref_free_bypass build their symbols in code; objc-resolve-test.sh builds them alike.
# Scope "refused" marks what src/objc/demangle-v0.c refuses by design: it must refuse, never print
# other text. Every other row it must print exactly.
